name: pr-skills
description: Claude Code skills for pull requests and drupal.org projects: pr-fix diagnoses and fixes failing PRs in DDEV projects, pr-triage lists the PRs that need your review, setup-checkout clones or updates a drupal.org checkout with DDEV, update-docs keeps the README, docs and project page current, setup-docs publishes docs/ with MkDocs, and create-release tags and publishes releases.
